messages:
elaine: Heads-up  final announce planned Wed 09:00 PT. Need ENG to freeze canonical changelog URL, publish a single redirect landing, and confirm canary windows. Any blockers?
hiro: I'll push the changelog + redirect by EOD. Landing will be /release/nov-2024 and include anchors #notes #migrate #webinar.
pete: Proposed canary schedule: 09:00 PT start, 25m canary -> ramp to 60% over 45m -> hold 90m -> full at +2:30 if all checks pass. Rollback if 5xx > 0.15% for 5m or p95 latency +10%.
elaine: Marketing asks: two A/B subject lines (12h), tweet copy, and a 25-30s webinar blurb. Can someone paste drafts?
hiro: Subjects: A) "Announcing safer LLM rollouts and lower inference costs" B) "New canary workflows & smarter batching to cut production cost"
hiro: Tweet: "Lower inference costs and upgrade risk with smarter batching, KV cache, and canary rollouts. Read + register: https://events.redwood.ai/nov24"
pete: Migration snippet for the post/docs (2 bullets): "1) Pin current model/version before upgrading. 2) Start at 10% canary traffic; verify p95 & 5xx thresholds, then ramp."
elaine: Inbound routing: registration form should set headers X-Region + X-UTM so Sales can route NA/EMEA/APAC. Example payload in staging below.
marketing-bot: infra-bot: staging example payload:
```http
POST /api/register
Headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Region":"APAC","X-UTM":"nov24-announce"}
Body: {"email":"user@example.com","name":"User"}
```
hiro: Final changelog (will be live today): https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2024-11/nov24-changelog.html
pete: Pager rota: eng-oncall -> hiro, eng-sre -> sam. Ops reminder set for 08:50 PT.
elaine: Also need a short 3-line blog header + a 1-paragraph announcement intro. Drop drafts here.
hiro: Blog header (3 lines): "Today we launch targeted rollout tooling for production inference. Smarter batching and KV caching reduce unit cost. Join our webinar for a live demo (Wed 09:00 PT)."
pete: Announcement intro paragraph: "We're rolling out canary workflows, batching improvements, and migration guides to make inference updates safer and more cost-efficient. Read the changelog and join our webinar for a walkthrough."
marketing-bot: infra-bot: scheduled canary: 2024-11-13T09:00:00-08:00 -> canary_end 09:25, ramp 09:25-10:10, hold until 11:30, full 11:30. PD contacts: hiro, sam. Reminder ping 08:45 PT.
elaine: Great  I'll assemble the assets (tweet, A/B subjects, header image, migration bullets) and schedule the announce. Thanks team :rocket:
hiro: :thumbsup:
pete: +1
